  cardMarketContent = '## Ant-Man: Small Hero, Big Card Potential

Ant-Man (2015) was another Marvel gamble that paid off — turning a lesser-known hero into a $519 million success. Paul Rudd''s comedic charm made Ant-Man an instant fan favorite, and the character''s importance grew significantly through Civil War and the Quantum Realm storyline.

### Key Sets

The **2015 Upper Deck Ant-Man** set features autographs from Paul Rudd, Michael Douglas, and Evangeline Lilly. This was the first major card set for these characters and remains the primary source for Ant-Man family autograph cards.

### Market Trends

Paul Rudd autograph cards are popular due to his broad appeal beyond just MCU fans. Michael Douglas cards carry Hollywood legend premium. Evangeline Lilly cards gained value as the Wasp became a co-lead in the sequel. The Quantum Realm connection to Endgame has boosted interest in all Ant-Man cards.',
  keyCards = '- **Paul Rudd as Ant-Man Autograph** — Beloved actor''s MCU debut card ($1,500+)
- **Michael Douglas as Hank Pym Auto** — Hollywood legend card ($800+)
- **Evangeline Lilly as Hope van Dyne Auto** — Future Wasp''s debut ($600+)
- **Corey Stoll as Yellowjacket Auto** — Underrated villain card ($300+)
- **Michael Pena as Luis Auto** — Fan-favorite scene-stealer ($400+)
- **2015 Upper Deck Ant-Man Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 quantum realm artwork',
  content = '## The Little Hero That Could

Ant-Man closed out Phase 2 with a refreshingly small-scale (literally) adventure. After the world-ending stakes of Age of Ultron, Peyton Reed delivered a heist film that proved the MCU could work at any scale. Paul Rudd brought his trademark charm to Scott Lang, creating one of the MCU''s most relatable and likeable heroes.

## The Legacy

- **Introduced the Quantum Realm** — This concept became absolutely crucial to Avengers: Endgame''s time travel plot
- **Paul Rudd as an Action Star** — Nobody expected it, but Rudd became a perfect MCU hero
- **The Heist Genre** — Proved the MCU could successfully blend superhero action with other genres
- **Michael Douglas in the MCU** — Brought old Hollywood prestige to the franchise
- **Luis''s Storytelling** — Michael Pena''s recap scenes became some of the most beloved comedy in the MCU

## Fun Facts

- Edgar Wright (Shaun of the Dead) originally developed Ant-Man for years before leaving due to creative differences
- Paul Rudd co-wrote the screenplay with Adam McKay (The Big Short)
- The Thomas the Tank Engine fight scene was one of the most expensive sequences in the film
- Michael Douglas watched all previous MCU films to prepare for his role
- The Falcon fight scene was added to connect Ant-Man to the broader MCU

## Viewing Context

Ant-Man is the **twelfth and final MCU Phase 2 film**. While largely standalone, it connects to the broader MCU through the Falcon cameo and the Quantum Realm, which becomes essential to Endgame. The post-credits scene directly sets up Captain America: Civil War.',

Michael Douglas Hank Pym autos ($800+) carry Hollywood legend premium.
